system.description:
• Effect: As an action, curse one creature within 30ft: Will save or have Disadvantage on one of: attack rolls, saving throws of one kind (Fortitude, Reflex or Will), or attribute checks (your choice when you cast it) for the encounter.
    • While hexed, it also takes 1d6 necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns (2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 9th, 4d6 at 13th, 5d6 at 17th), and repeats the Will save at the end of each of its turns, ending the Hex on a success.
    • The Disadvantage never applies to saves against the Hex itself.
    • You can Hex at will.
    • You can have only one Hex active; a new Hex ends the old one.
    • Remove Curse ends a Hex.
  • 15th: a creature makes its first save against your Hex with Disadvantage.
